subject: collinearity in log regression / order in glm/lrm statement

messages.author: eb09e8497b635c23
messages.subject: collinearity in log regression / order in glm/lrm statement
parts:
hi all,

I have got a question concerning collinearity problems in log
regression models that contain only factors.

I would like to fit a log reg model with 10 factors. Many of these
factors are correlated and sometimes several factors line up to
predict another variable.

following crawley 2007:327 I would like to proceed via stepwise model
simplification. so I start by fitting a maximal model that fits all
factors of interest, then inspect the parameters and remove the least
significant terms one at a time until only sig terms are retained.

I understand that in such a case a lot depends on the order the terms
are entered into the glm/lrm statement.
Every order threatens to produce a different result making it very
hard to simplify & arrive at the best model.
